material.acceptance_criteria: The header comment at panels.lua:4 names the parsed object shape that setup receives, matching panels.lua:836 and play.js:345.
material.description: scenarios/moba/panels.lua:4 documents setup's args.ui as 'moba_ui.json text'. The page sends { ui: UI, player, pubkey } as JSON object text (js/client/play.js:345), and panels.lua:836 reads it as a table (UI = args.ui or {}, then UI.teams and UI.text). A maintainer who follows the header would reproduce the wrong payload type.

notes.note: Also: the node-type list in the header (panels.lua:1-12) omits 'image', which image() emits at panels.lua:98. Same stale-header defect, one row.

material.subject: Header comment says setup args.ui is moba_ui.json text, but the page sends a parsed object
material.witness: Header fixed. Codesearch (session verify-commentsmell-trav-hud-lua-1, dispatch 1792863245943-5126-edef6aa59aaba61b): panels.lua:4 now says args.ui is the parsed moba_ui.json object; line 12 lists the image node. Publish e7fccdb8; CI green on head 4b24d0bc.
material.witness_plan: Grep the header and the setup branch: the comment's payload type matches what play.js:345 sends.
